# ResuFlex

> ResuFlex is a free, browser-based resume builder where every section can be split side by side or top to bottom, resized by dragging dividers, filled with text blocks from a + button, and formatted with bullets, alignment, fonts, sizes and colors. Resumes export to PDF (A4) or Word (.doc). No account is needed; data stays in the user's browser.

## Key facts
- Price: free, no sign-up
- Storage: browser local storage on the user's device; nothing is uploaded
- Page size: A4 (210 × 297 mm)
- Exports: PDF via the browser print dialog, Word .doc download
- Layout presets: Classic (header + two columns), Single column (best for ATS), Sidebar

## How to use
1. Pick a layout preset from Presets.
2. Select a section and split it side by side or top & bottom; drag dividers to resize (Snap = 5% steps; arrow keys on a focused divider).
3. Click the + button inside a section to add a Heading, Label, Paragraph, Bullet list, Label + date or Small print block.
4. Select text to open the formatting toolbar: font, size, bold, italic, underline, bulleted list, numbered list, left/center/right/justify, color, clear formatting.
5. Export with PDF or Word.
